Gold-Tone Writing Instrument Set

275394421.description:
Waterman Paris
Striped Lacquer Fountain Pen - Gold Trim
Late 20th Century, France
This Waterman Paris fountain pen exemplifies the elegant French design and reliable engineering that defined the brand's production after moving operations to France in the mid-20th century. Featuring a slim, sophisticated profile, the barrel and cap are finished in a dark lacquer with subtle vertical burgundy stripes, complemented by gold-tone accents and rings. The Waterman brand, established in 1884, is renowned for inventing the first functional fountain pen feed, a legacy of quality visible in this late vintage example.
Marked "WATERMAN MADE IN FRANCE" on the central gold-tone band
Gold-tone nib featuring the Waterman "W" logo and ornate scrollwork
Includes original blue Waterman Paris presentation box with white satin lining
Original user manual booklet and one blue ink cartridge included
Condition:
Excellent vintage condition. The pen body shows only very light surface micro-scratches consistent with careful storage and minimal use. The gold trim is bright and free of pitting or significant tarnish. The nib appears clean and well-maintained. The presentation box and paperwork are in very good condition with minor shelf wear to the outer casing.

This assortment is appropriate for students, collectors, or individuals interested in geology or gemstones.

275861303.description:
Mixed Geological Specimen Lot
Amethyst, Pumice, Granite, and River Stones
29 Items, Mixed Vintage
This diverse collection of geological specimens offers a variety of rock types and minerals, perfect for beginning collectors or educators. The lot includes igneous, metamorphic, and sedimentary samples showcasing different natural textures and formation processes found in nature.
ITEMS INCLUDED:
1.
Amethyst Cluster
- Natural purple quartz crystals on a white stone matrix
2.
Volcanic Rocks
- Multiple pieces of porous black and brown pumice and scoria
3.
Granite Specimens
- Multi-mineral crystalline rocks showing feldspar and mica
4.
River Stones
- Various water-worn smooth pebbles in earth tones
5.
Fossil Fragment
- Large textured brown specimen with potential grain or fossil structure
6.
Buckeye Seed
- Single organic horse chestnut/buckeye seed
7.
Sedimentary Rocks
- Sandstone and layered rock fragments
8.
Mixed Mineral Specimens
- Assorted quartz, basalt, and field stones
Condition:
Good natural condition. Most specimens are raw and unpolished, exhibiting natural fractures and textures. The amethyst cluster points appear intact. The buckeye seed is dry and solid. No artificial treatments or coatings are visible on the stones.
